name: T1D
description: Type 1 diabetes mellitus; the underlying chronic condition modeled by this graph.

name: Age
description: Patient age in years.

name: Sex
description: Patient sex.

name: T1D_Duration
description: Years since T1D diagnosis; duration is a cardiovascular risk modifier in T1D.

name: HbA1c
description: Glycated hemoglobin measurement reflecting longer-term glycemic exposure.

name: Systolic_BP
description: Systolic blood pressure.

name: Diastolic_BP
description: Diastolic blood pressure.

name: Hypertension
description: Hypertension; an established cardiovascular risk factor in people with T1D.

name: LDL_Cholesterol
description: Low-density lipoprotein cholesterol concentration.

name: HDL_Cholesterol
description: High-density lipoprotein cholesterol concentration.

name: Triglycerides
description: Serum triglyceride concentration.

name: Dyslipidemia
description: Abnormal lipid profile relevant to cardiovascular risk.

name: Smoking
description: Current tobacco exposure/status; a modifiable cardiovascular risk factor.

name: Obesity
description: Excess adiposity/obesity, a cardiovascular risk modifier.

name: UACR
description: Urine albumin-to-creatinine ratio, a marker of albuminuria and cardiorenal risk.

name: Albuminuria
description: Abnormally increased urinary albumin excretion.

name: eGFR
description: Estimated glomerular filtration rate, used to characterize kidney function.

name: Chronic_Kidney_Disease
description: Chronic kidney disease; an important cardiovascular risk modifier in diabetes.

name: Cardiovascular_Risk
description: Risk state representing elevated likelihood of cardiovascular disease/events.

name: ASCVD
description: Atherosclerotic cardiovascular disease, including coronary, cerebrovascular, and peripheral arterial disease.

name: Myocardial_Infarction
description: Acute myocardial infarction.

name: Stroke
description: Stroke due to cerebrovascular disease.

name: Peripheral_Artery_Disease
description: Peripheral artery disease.

name: Heart_Failure
description: Clinical heart failure, including preserved or reduced ejection fraction phenotypes.

name: Heart_Failure_Risk
description: Risk state for developing heart failure.

name: BNP_NTproBNP
description: Natriuretic peptide biomarker used in heart-failure risk assessment/screening.

name: ECG_Abnormality
description: Electrocardiographic abnormality that may prompt cardiovascular investigation.

name: Coronary_Artery_Disease
description: Coronary artery disease / coronary heart disease.

name: Cardiovascular_Death
description: Death attributable to cardiovascular disease.

name: MACE
description: Composite cardiovascular outcome; exact component definition depends on the study/source.

name: Heart_Failure_Evaluation_Indicated
description: State indicating that heart-failure evaluation is indicated after an abnormal natriuretic peptide result.

name: Secondary_Cardiovascular_Prevention_Context
description: Context representing established ASCVD in a person with T1D.

name: Coronary_Investigation_Considered
description: State indicating that coronary/vascular investigation may be considered based on symptoms, vascular findings, or ECG abnormality.
